name: X assistant
tagline: Each weekday morning it rounds up the X posts worth answering, read-only.
description: Before your workday starts, this one catches up on your X activity: fresh mentions, conversation around the products you ship, and movement on the subjects you follow. What comes back is a compact, ranked list of the posts actually worth answering. It never posts, likes or follows on its own, looking is all it does.
author: dragosroua
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
